name: vg-brain-capture
description: VG Brain autosave, for the people Liam has set up with it (Alex and Joe). Uploads every Claude Code session to your OWN VG Brain notes at session end, before a compact, and on catch-up after a missed upload; loads your brain context when a session starts; and sets the VG Assistant output style. It carries NO brain tools: search, save and share come from the VG Brain connector in claude.ai. Its connection to vg-brain.com is sign-in only, so the hooks can reach your notes. Install it on its own; uninstall the old vg-brain plugin.
